Check the number of rows in each group

Source: R/groups.R
ysx_check_repeats.Rd

Groups the data by every column with group: true in spec (see ysx_regroup()) and reports groups that do not have exactly count rows. This is equivalent to counting rows by the group columns and checking that none has n != count. Missing values count as a group value.

Usage

ysx_check_repeats(data, spec, count = 1, error_on_fail = TRUE, groups = NULL)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

spec

A loaded yspec object.

count

The required number of rows in every group; a single positive whole number. The default, 1, means that group values must be unique.

error_on_fail

If TRUE (default), an error is raised when a group column in spec does not exist in data, or when any group does not have count rows. If FALSE, nothing is raised; problems are returned and only the group columns found in data are used.

groups

Optional character vector of columns that define the groups, used instead of the group: true columns in spec. See ysx_regroup().

Value

Invisibly, character(0) if no problems are found. With error_on_fail = FALSE, a character vector describing any problems.

Details

If groups is supplied, it replaces the group columns of spec first, as with ysx_regroup(), so the whole check can be written as one call. If there are no group columns, nothing can be checked and character(0) is returned.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ysx_check_repeats(aetab, spec, groups = c("USUBJIDN", "AFRLT", "DCXLFLN"))
} # }
